posts.title: Bobino Bagel
posts.description: Anju Road Rating: ★★★ A well-executed bagel shop concept that gets lost in that sweet, sweet sauce.

posts.title: Fragrant Noodles鼎香面馆
posts.description: Anju Road Rating: ★★★★ Run, don't walk to Ottawa's charming braised meat and noodle shop that captivates the senses with a rich array of flavours and dishes that evoke the comfort of home. Braised Beef Offal Noodle Soup It's very rare that a restaurant makes you verbatim exclaim "WOW" after your first sip. Yet here I was finishing my first soul-warming slurp when the sentiment escaped from within

posts.title: Momofuku Noodle Bar
posts.description: Anju Road Rating: ★★★ Toronto's first Momofuku restaurant by David Chang, delivers hot bowls of ramen, noodles and a variety of buns, while splitting the top two levels with other concepts. Spicy Tsukemen Dipping Noodle I have a love/hate relationship with Noodle Bar. I want to love it more than I do. Spicy Tsukemen (pictured above) is up first, since it's the most redeeming bowl of noodles Momofu
